title: The Dry Tree
journal: Dralin Uveran sent me east up the road to Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, who had me freed. On the way, Jal-Veesa's tree-minder wants Sithis' beard, a grey moss hanging over the creek below Reed-Sill Weir. Crocodiles lie under the weir. I can fight them, shoot them from the log walk on top of the weir, or keep out of their sight. I'm to pick the moss.
objectives: Pick Sithis' beard below Reed-Sill Weir. (marker: Sithis' Beard)

plan.going: I am free; Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa had me freed and wants me. Her town's tree-minder wants Sithis' beard.
plan.next: Pick Sithis' beard below Reed-Sill Weir, then go on to Jal-Veesa.
plan.ways: Fight the crocodiles, shoot them from the log walk, or sneak to the moss behind them.

answers: I was freed from the Owing by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, via Dralin Uveran. I am heading east to her house, though I do not know why.
Pick Sithis beard (grey moss) below Reed-Sill Weir for the Jal-Veesa tree-minder, then continue east to Jal-Veesa.
Fight the crocodiles, shoot them from the log walk on top of the weir (my build favours shooting), or sneak past unseen.
I do not understand the Hist, the Owing, or why Vosh-Leera wants me, or why the tree-minder needs the moss. I could ask people in Jal-Veesa.

title: The Dry Tree
journal: I picked Sithis' beard below Reed-Sill Weir. I'm to bring it to Weeltul, the tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, at the Hist pool in the middle of the town, east along the road. The Hist is the town's great tree, a thinking tree: the tall grey one standing in the pool, with the stilt houses round it.
objectives: Bring Sithis' beard to the tree-minder at Jal-Veesa's Hist pool. (marker: Weeltul)

plan.going: I have the moss the tree-minder wanted. A Hist is a great thinking tree; Jal-Veesa's stands in the pool in the middle of the town.
plan.next: Bring the moss to the tree-minder at the Hist pool in the middle of Jal-Veesa.
plan.ways: One way, handing it to her.

answers: I killed the two young crocodiles and picked Sithis beard. Weeltul, tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, wants it at the Hist pool; Vosh-Leera also wants me in town.
Take the moss east to Weeltul at the Hist pool in the middle of Jal-Veesa.
Go straight there; then visit Vosh-Leera, and I could ask Weeltul or others questions.
I still do not know why the tree-minder needs the moss, why Vosh-Leera freed me, or what the Owing really is. The Hist seems to be the great grey tree; I can ask Weeltul.

title: The Dry Tree
journal: I gave the moss to Weeltul, the tree-minder of Jal-Veesa. The town's Hist is sick: its bark is dry and dark, its scar has closed and its egg-pool is cooling, and nobody knows why. If it dies, no egg here will hatch again. The moss only warms the pool. She let me lay a hand on the bark for its blessing. I'm to go to Vosh-Leera's House in the town.
objectives: Speak to Vosh-Leera in her house in Jal-Veesa. (marker: Vosh-Leera)

plan.going: Jal-Veesa's tree is sick (dry dark bark, a closed scar, a cooling egg-pool) for no known reason; if it dies the town's eggs never hatch. I have its blessing for a time.
plan.next: Go to Vosh-Leera's House and speak to her.

answers: The Hist of Jal-Veesa is sick: dry dark bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool. If it dies no eggs hatch and the town empties. The moss only warms the pool; nobody knows the cause. I got the tree blessing.
Speak to Vosh-Leera at her house in Jal-Veesa.
Talk to Vosh-Leera now, or first ask Weeltul about the eggs, sap, scar, and Umbriel.
I do not know what Umbriel is, why the scar closed, or why Vosh-Leera wants me. I can ask Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.

title: The Dry Tree
journal: Vosh-Leera told me who I work for now: the Toh-Reel-Ka, the "Secret Warriors" of the Xeech-Leel, who rule the province. They were made after Umbriel, when the An-Xileel used Lilmoth's mad tree to call a flying city down on the marsh, so that no tree and nobody allied with a tree can do it again. They free strangers like me because we come cheap and have no kin. She paid me fifty gold. She has a second task for me, and I'm to ask her for it here in her house in Jal-Veesa.

plan.going: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the secret order of the Xeech-Leel who rule the province, made to stop another Umbriel. I was freed because a stranger with no kin is a cheap spy. The trees are sick.
plan.next: Ask Vosh-Leera for her second task, here in her house (MN03 stage 10).

answers: I now work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, secret warriors of the Xeech-Leel who rule the marsh. Trees are falling sick along the river and they want the cause found. They freed me because a stranger with no kin makes a cheap spy. I was paid 50 gold.
She has a second task; I am to return to her at her house in Jal-Veesa.
Take the second task, or leave, or ask Weeltul more about the sickness. I do not know what refusing would cost me.
I do not know why the trees sicken, what the An-Xileel and Xeech-Leel exactly are, or what the second task is. I can ask Vosh-Leera and Weeltul.
